shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Mobile sheets and true overlays only.

components.name: Selected navigation item
components.description: Current destination within the intent-grouped side navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { display:block; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:8px; color:#e7f1ef; background:#163035; font:600 14px Roboto,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; border-left:1px solid #79cfc3; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #79cfc3; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Freshness badge
components.description: Explicit readable freshness for live or stale account data.
components.css: .ds-freshness { display:inline-flex; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:999px; color:#829b97; background:#102124; font:650 12px Roboto,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Primary account value
components.description: Equity or P&L value with stable financial numerals.
components.css: .ds-metric { display:grid; gap:4px; color:#829b97; font:650 12px Roboto,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.045em; } .ds-metric strong { color:#e7f1ef; font-size:32px; line-height:1.1; letter-spacing:-.025em; text-transform:none; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Attention state
components.description: Actionable risk or account issue; healthy states do not use this treatment.
components.html: Account data is temporarily unavailableTradePilot is retrying the connection.
components.css: .ds-attention { display:grid; gap:2px; padding:12px; border-radius:8px; color:#ffd9e0; background:#301b21; font:400 13px/1.5 Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-attention strong { color:#e7f1ef; font-size:14px; }

components.name: Quiet surface
components.description: Primary content region using tonal depth rather than glass or decorative shadow.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding:16px; border:1px solid rgba(151,195,188,.2); border-radius:12px; color:#e7f1ef; background:#0a1719; font:400 14px/1.5 Roboto,sans-serif; }

components.name: Operational page header
components.description: A compact route heading that establishes the active workspace without a marketing hero treatment.
components.css: .ds-page-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(151,195,188,.12); color:#e7f1ef; font:400 14px/1.5 Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-page-header p { margin:0 0 4px; color:#829b97; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-page-header h1 { margin:0; font-size:24px; line-height:1.2; } .ds-page-header span { color:#829b97; }

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The single next action for a local workflow. Destructive actions use the negative semantic state instead.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { min-height:40px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:#061314; background:#79cfc3; font:650 14px Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background:#a6e3da; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #79cfc3; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Operational field
components.description: A form field for configuration and account settings. Focus is explicit and uses the teal accent without a glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#b4c8c4; font:650 12px Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:40px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid rgba(151,195,188,.2); border-radius:8px; color:#e7f1ef; background:#0a1719; font:400 14px Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#79cfc3; outline:2px solid #79cfc3; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Data table
components.description: Dense operational evidence. Numeric columns use tabular figures and status has a readable text label.
components.css: .ds-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:#e7f1ef; background:#0a1719; font:400 14px Roboto,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-table th { padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(151,195,188,.12); color:#829b97; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.045em; text-align:left; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-table td { padding:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(151,195,188,.12); }

narrative.overview: TradePilot is a restrained, high-signal workstation for monitoring live account and market state. Its visual authority comes from composure: a quiet dark-teal canvas, precise tonal layering, explicit freshness, legible risk language and financial numerals that remain stable while data changes. The system is refined rather than replaced. Brand appears through disciplined teal accents and surface temperature, not glow or novelty. Hierarchy answers account health and required attention before secondary detail.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Colour may reinforce a state but never carry its meaning alone.

dos: Do lead with account health, risk and required attention.
Do keep healthy system state compact.
Do use semantic tokens and tabular numerals on changed surfaces.
Do preserve loading, partial, empty, error and stale data readability.
donts: Don't use neon, glowing borders, decorative gradients or glass as a visual shortcut.
Don't fade an entire surface to communicate stale data.
Don't create same-weight card grids that hide priority.
Don't present AI interpretation without provenance and freshness.
Don't alter business logic or execution semantics through visual work.
